title: South Shore 30A
meta_description: South Shore 30A: Gulf-front 2BR condo with ocean views, private balcony, beach access, pool, and Crabby Steve's onsite. Includes beach chairs.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: This 2-bedroom, 2 bath Gulf front condo comfortably sleeps six. Gulf views from the moment you open the door. Wake up to beautiful Gulf views in the master bedroom with a king size bed and ensuite, complete with a spacious walk-in shower. The guest room has two queen size beds and a bathroom: complete with a single vanity and shower/tub combo. The kitchen, living and dining space is an open concept floor plan with great Gulf Views! The dining table comfortably seats six with three additional seats at the kitchen bar. Enjoy stunning sunrises and sunsets from the private balcony with access from the master bedroom or living room.

ABOUT THE AREA: There is nowhere better to spend your days riding the waves of relaxation than South Shore 30A. When you can finally recover from the breathtaking Gulf views, walk through the open living and dining space and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless appliances. Step onto the private patio and take a seat at the table or on the lounger and take in the salty air. Just 50 yards away you can be lounging in the lagoon pool or having a bite to eat at Crabby Steve's restaurant.

BEACH ACCESS: High Pointe Private Beach

BEACH RENTALS: From March 1st -- October 31, this home comes with 2 complimentary beach chairs and 1 umbrella.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 6
• Bedroom 1 -- King Master with Ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen (2)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Ocean front
• Private Beach Boardwalk
• Complimentary umbrella set up with 2 beach chairs
• Community Pool (Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a Lagoon Pool, Waterfall Feature, Kiddie Pool \& Hot Tub)
• Beach front Bar \& Grill -- Crabby Steve's
• Fully fenced in Playground
• Tennis Courts -- Pro onsite
• Shuffleboard Courts
• Pickleball Court
• Practice Turf/Driving Cage
• BBQ Grills
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Coffee Maker
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, hand soap, bar of soap for shower
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- This unit is located on the 2nd floor.

Parking Details:
- Private parking for High Pointe Resort.
- The parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
